_comment: Pattern library for unslop.py. Each entry: id, category, regex (case-insensitive), weight (how loudly it screams 'AI'), label, fix. Add your own with --extra my_patterns.json using the same shape.

patterns.label: "delve"
patterns.fix: look at, dig into, cover - or just start talking about the thing

patterns.label: "tapestry"
patterns.fix: say what the parts actually are

patterns.label: "a testament to"
patterns.fix: shows, proves - or cut the sentence

patterns.label: "in the realm/world/landscape of"
patterns.fix: in, or name the field directly

patterns.label: "ever-evolving landscape"
patterns.fix: name the actual market or situation

patterns.label: "navigate the complexities"
patterns.fix: deal with, handle, figure out

patterns.label: intricate / multifaceted / nuanced
patterns.fix: complicated, or explain the specific complication

patterns.label: pivotal / paramount / crucial
patterns.fix: important, key - or show why it matters

patterns.label: leverage / utilize / harness
patterns.fix: use

patterns.label: seamless / robust / cutting-edge / game-changer
patterns.fix: say what it does and let the reader judge

patterns.label: foster / empower / elevate / unlock / embark
patterns.fix: build, help, improve, start

patterns.label: showcase / underscore / boasts
patterns.fix: shows, has

patterns.label: meticulous / vibrant / bustling
patterns.fix: a concrete detail beats an adjective

patterns.label: "journey" (not travel)
patterns.fix: the actual thing: career, project, year

patterns.label: synergy / holistic / paradigm / deep dive
patterns.fix: plain words

patterns.label: Moreover, / Furthermore, / Additionally,
patterns.fix: drop it, or use 'also', 'and', 'so'

patterns.label: "plays a crucial role"
patterns.fix: say what it does

patterns.label: "in today's fast-paced world"
patterns.fix: delete - nobody needs the era described

patterns.regex: \b(?:(?:it'?s|this is|that'?s|it was|this was|that was)\s+not|isn'?t|wasn'?t|aren'?t|weren'?t|is not|are not|was not)\s+(?:just\s+|only\s+|merely\s+|simply\s+|really\s+)?(?:about\s+)?[^.;!?\n]{1,60}?(?:[,;—–]|\s-\s|\.)\s*(?:it'?s|it is|this is|that'?s|it was|they'?re|but)\b
patterns.label: "It's not X, it's Y" / "This isn't about X. It's about Y"
patterns.fix: just say Y. The fake contrast is the #1 AI tell

patterns.label: "not only... but also"
patterns.fix: use 'and'

patterns.label: "less about X, more about Y"
patterns.fix: say Y

patterns.label: "The result? ..." self-answered question
patterns.fix: state the result in a normal sentence

patterns.regex: \b(here'?s the thing|here'?s the (kicker|catch|truth|deal|secret)|but here'?s where it gets interesting|and that'?s the point|let that sink in|read that again)\b
patterns.label: "Here's the thing:" / "Let that sink in"
patterns.fix: cut the drumroll; say the thing

patterns.regex: \b(one thing|the answer|the key|the secret|the lesson|the truth|the reason|the result) (is|was) (simple|clear|this)\s*[:.\u2014]
patterns.label: "The answer is simple:"
patterns.fix: just give the answer

patterns.label: "I hope this email finds you well"
patterns.fix: open with the reason you're writing

patterns.label: "Great question!"
patterns.fix: answer the question

patterns.label: "Certainly!" / "Absolutely!"
patterns.fix: start with the content

patterns.label: "Let's dive in"
patterns.fix: just start

patterns.label: "I'm thrilled to announce"
patterns.fix: say the news

patterns.regex: \bi am writing to (express|inform|let you know|follow up|apply)\b
patterns.label: "I am writing to express"
patterns.fix: the reader knows you're writing

patterns.label: "when it comes to"
patterns.fix: for, with, or restructure

patterns.label: "I hope this helps"
patterns.fix: end when the content ends

patterns.regex: \b(please )?(don'?t hesitate to|feel free to) (reach out|contact|let me know|ask)\b
patterns.label: "Don't hesitate to reach out"
patterns.fix: one specific ask, or nothing

patterns.regex: \blet me know if you have any (other |further |more )?(questions|thoughts|concerns)\b
patterns.label: "Let me know if you have any questions"
patterns.fix: ask the one question you need answered

patterns.regex: (^|[.!?]\s+|\n)(in conclusion|in summary|to sum up|to summarize|all in all|ultimately|at the end of the day),
patterns.label: "In conclusion," / "Ultimately,"
patterns.fix: the last point is the conclusion; skip the label

patterns.label: "Happy to help!"
patterns.fix: cut

patterns.regex: (^|\n)\s*(thoughts|agree|what do you think|what are your thoughts)\?\s*(\S{1,4})?\s*$
patterns.label: LinkedIn "Thoughts?" / "Agree?" ending
patterns.fix: ask a real question or none

patterns.label: "It's worth noting that"
patterns.fix: just note it

patterns.regex: \b(generally speaking|in many cases|in some cases|to some extent|it can be argued|arguably|it depends on various factors)\b
patterns.label: generally speaking / to some extent
patterns.fix: commit, or say what it depends on

patterns.label: "can help improve"
patterns.fix: say what it does and by how much

patterns.label: truly / genuinely / incredibly
patterns.fix: delete; the sentence gets stronger

patterns.regex: \b(passionate about|deeply committed to|strong passion for|dedicated to excellence)\b
patterns.label: "passionate about"
patterns.fix: show one thing you did because of it

patterns.label: "You're absolutely right!"
patterns.fix: agree with substance or not at all

patterns.label: **Bold label:** bullet
patterns.fix: fine in docs; in emails and posts, write sentences

patterns.label: emoji-as-bullet (🚀 ✅ 💡 👉)
patterns.fix: plain text or real bullets

patterns.label: markdown header
patterns.fix: headers don't belong in emails, DMs or posts

patterns.label: ", highlighting the importance of..." tail
patterns.fix: end the sentence at the fact; the tacked-on meaning is filler

patterns.label: "serves as a" (instead of "is")
patterns.fix: is

patterns.label: "experts say" (no source)
patterns.fix: name the source or drop the claim

patterns.label: "from X to Y, from A to B" false range
patterns.fix: list the actual things, or pick one

patterns.regex: \b(the future (is|looks) bright|exciting times (are )?ahead|stay tuned|the possibilities are endless|only time will tell)\b
patterns.label: "The future looks bright"
patterns.fix: end on the last real point
